evidence_observation: Users repeatedly could not distinguish folders vs subfolders.
evidence_log_trace: Debrief sessions 1-5: folder/subfolder confusion appears every session.
action_taken: Redesigned dashboard and full-list views with dedicated folder tree/left panel and clearer hierarchy.

evidence_observation: Users scrolled or disengaged while waiting; one timeout/server-error period observed.
evidence_log_trace: Session notes include multiple latency comments and one server-error episode.
action_taken: Model/config tuning plus fallback adjustments; further hard timeout strategy still being tuned.
Adjusted image-source flow and clarified picker labeling/handling.

evidence_observation: PDF export required profile name but registration initially omitted name.
action_taken: Added name input at account creation.

evidence_observation: Selected avatar was not obvious during signup.
evidence_log_trace: Session notes mention unclear selected icon.
action_taken: Improved selected-state affordance in avatar picker.

evidence_observation: Toolkit visible before mandatory image upload made users think they could write immediately.
